en.title: MacroFactor Alternative for GLP-1 Users: An Honest 2026 Comparison — HAVIT vs MacroFactor
en.meta_description: Looking for a MacroFactor alternative on a GLP-1? What MacroFactor's macro coaching does brilliantly, why it doesn't track your dose, and what to look for.
en.tldr: Looking for a MacroFactor alternative on a GLP-1? What MacroFactor's macro coaching does brilliantly, why it doesn't track your dose, and what to look for.
en.body_md:
*Medical disclaimer: This article is for general education only and is not medical advice, diagnosis, or dosing guidance. GLP-1 medications are prescription drugs with serious potential risks. Always follow your prescriber's instructions and the FDA-approved label. Never change your dose based on an app.*

If you're on Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro, or Zepbound and you searched for a "MacroFactor alternative," there's a good chance you already respect the app — its macro coaching is arguably the smartest on the market — but you've hit its wall: **it was never built for the medication side of your journey.**

This is an honest, vendor-neutral comparison. MacroFactor is a genuinely excellent nutrition-coaching app, and for data-driven dieters it's hard to beat. We'll give it full credit for what it does better than almost anyone, be direct about the gap it leaves for GLP-1 users, and lay out what to look for in an alternative. The question isn't whether MacroFactor is good — it's whether macro coaching alone is what you need on a weekly shot.

## What MacroFactor Does Well

MacroFactor was built by Greg Nuckols and Eric Trexler of Stronger By Science, and it earned its reputation among evidence-minded users for a reason.

### Adaptive TDEE that actually adapts

MacroFactor's signature is an **adaptive expenditure algorithm** that recalculates your total daily energy expenditure every week from your real weight trends and logged intake — not a generic formula ([MacroFactor](https://macrofactor.com/macrofactor/)). As your body responds, your calorie and macro targets adjust automatically. It's the closest thing to a nutrition coach in an algorithm.

### Genuinely smart macro and protein coaching

You can let the algorithm set your macros (coached mode) or set your own ratios and let it adjust calories (collaborative mode) ([Arvo: MacroFactor Pricing 2026](https://arvo.guru/vs/macrofactor)). For a protein-preservation goal, that flexibility is valuable — you can lock a high protein target and let the app manage the rest. Weekly check-ins and clean dashboards make the whole thing feel like coaching.

### A verified, high-accuracy database

MacroFactor uses an **NCC-derived verified food database** rather than user-submitted entries ([NutriScan: MacroFactor Cost 2026](https://nutriscan.app/blog/posts/macrofactor-cost-2026-free-version-29f5edc98b)). When it says a food has 6 grams of protein, you can generally trust it — genuinely useful when you're chasing protein on a suppressed appetite. Barcode scanning, custom foods, a habit tracker, and a period tracker round it out.

## Where MacroFactor Falls Short for GLP-1 Users

Here's the honest core: **MacroFactor is a nutrition-coaching app, full stop.** For someone whose whole routine revolves around a weekly injection, that's a fundamental mismatch.

### 1. No dose or injection tracking

MacroFactor has no field for your medication, your dose in milligrams, or your injection date. You can dial in your macros perfectly and still have no record of when you took your shot. For a once-weekly medication, that's the single most important thing to track — and it's absent.

### 2. No side-effect log

Roughly **40–70% of GLP-1 users experience GI side effects** like nausea and constipation ([BioSpace](https://www.biospace.com/drug-development/glp-1-side-effects-only-one-factor-driving-patient-discontinuation-rates)). Logging symptoms against your dose timeline is one of the highest-value GLP-1 habits — you learn that nausea peaks two days post-shot and plan meals around it. MacroFactor's coaching is built around expenditure and macros, not a medication schedule.

### 3. No body composition view

MacroFactor tracks your weight trend brilliantly, but it doesn't estimate body composition. On a GLP-1, **the lean-mass share of weight lost has ranged from 40–60% in some trials to 15% or less in others** ([Neeland et al., *Diabetes, Obesity and Metabolism*, 2024](https://dom-pubs.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/dom.15728)). A falling weight trend looks like success even when you're losing muscle — and MacroFactor can't tell you which.

### 4. No shot reminders or titration support

There's no countdown to your next injection, no missed-dose handling, and no awareness that your dose is scheduled to step up. MacroFactor's reminders are built around logging and weigh-ins, not a medication schedule.

### 5. Paid only — no free tier

MacroFactor has **no free version and never will**; it costs about $11.99/month, $7.99/month on the 6-month plan, or $5.99/month annually ($71.99/year), after a 7-day free trial ([Arvo](https://arvo.guru/vs/macrofactor), [NutriScan](https://nutriscan.app/blog/posts/macrofactor-cost-2026-free-version-29f5edc98b)). The coaching is worth it for the right user — but there's no free path if you just want to log your shot.

## Comparison Table: MacroFactor vs Dedicated GLP-1 Trackers

The honest framing: MacroFactor is a best-in-class **macro-coaching app**; dedicated GLP-1 trackers are **medication-and-body-first apps**. They're solving different problems.

*Features and pricing change frequently — verify in the App Store or Google Play before you commit. Sources: [MacroFactor](https://macrofactor.com/macrofactor/), [Arvo](https://arvo.guru/vs/macrofactor), [NutriScan](https://nutriscan.app/blog/posts/macrofactor-cost-2026-free-version-29f5edc98b).*

### The bottom line on the gap

The gap isn't that MacroFactor is weak — it's that it's playing a different sport. It wins macro coaching and adaptive TDEE hands-down. But it tracks **zero** of the medication signals that define a GLP-1 journey (dose, injection date, side effects, schedule), and it can't tell you whether you're losing fat or muscle. No amount of macro precision fills those holes.

## Who Should Stay on MacroFactor — and Who Should Switch

**Stay on MacroFactor if:**
- Adaptive TDEE and precise macro coaching are your top priorities.
- You're happy logging your medication separately, elsewhere.
- You value nutrition-coaching depth over medication features in one place.
- The subscription is worth it for how you eat and train.

**Consider an alternative if:**
- You want your dose, injection date, and side effects in the same app as your food.
- You want to see whether weight is coming off as fat or muscle.
- You need shot reminders and titration awareness.
- You'd rather not pay a subscription just to track your shot.

A reasonable middle path: some users **pair** MacroFactor (for macro coaching) with a dedicated GLP-1 tracker (for the shot). That works — it just means two apps and a subscription.

## What to Look For in a MacroFactor Alternative

If you switch, or add a second app, judge candidates on GLP-1 fundamentals:

1. **Dose + injection tracking** — the core MacroFactor can't do at all.
2. **Side-effect logging tied to your dose timeline** — so you can spot and plan around patterns.
3. **Protein-first food logging** — appetite drops on a GLP-1, and under-eating protein risks muscle loss.
4. **Body composition awareness** — know whether you're losing fat or muscle, not just weight.
5. **Reminders and titration support** — countdowns and awareness of dose step-ups.
6. **Privacy** — most U.S. wellness apps aren't HIPAA-covered; read the policy, prefer export/delete controls.
7. **A free path** — for many GLP-1 users, an app they can start free beats coaching they'll pay for but not use.

## A Note on Accuracy and Safety

No app replaces your care team — not MacroFactor, not any alternative. Body-composition figures from a phone are estimates, and any "estimated medication-level" curve is an educational approximation based on published half-lives, never a measurement of the drug in your body. Use whatever you track to bring **better questions to your clinician**, and never adjust your dose because of what an app shows.

## The Bottom Line

MacroFactor is the best macro coach in the category, and if adaptive TDEE and precise protein targets are your goal, it deserves its reputation. But it tracks none of the medication signals that define a GLP-1 journey — dose, injection date, side effects, or schedule — and it can't tell you whether you're losing fat or muscle. That's not a flaw; it's simply not what MacroFactor is for.

If you want GLP-1 injection tracking, protein-first food logging, an AI body-composition estimate so you can protect muscle, and gentle coaching in one place — organized around your shot instead of around a macro algorithm — **[try the HAVIT app](https://www.aihavit.com/)**. It's built to keep you consistent on your GLP-1 journey, one week at a time. And if you love MacroFactor's coaching, there's nothing stopping you from using both.

## HAVIT: One App for Your Whole Healthy Lifestyle, Not Just Meals, Nutrition, and Calories

GLP-1 medications can meaningfully reduce weight — but the number on the scale is only part of the story. The lean-mass share of the weight lost on GLP-1 therapy has ranged from 40–60% in some trials to 15% or less in others — and lean mass counts organs, bone and fluid, not only muscle ([Neeland et al., 2024](https://dom-pubs.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/dom.15728)), and results tend to fade once the medication stops unless new habits take their place. That's why leading guidance treats medication as one part of care, not the whole: the U.S. Preventive Services Task Force recommends that adults with obesity be offered intensive, multicomponent behavioral interventions ([USPSTF, Grade B](https://www.uspreventiveservicestaskforce.org/uspstf/recommendation/obesity-in-adults-interventions)).

**HAVIT is an AI diet coach app built by experts from Juvis Diet, one of Korea's leading diet clinics.** It goes beyond tracking meals, nutrition, and calories. Body composition, sleep, exercise, and mental well-being all live in the same app. At the clinic, staff guided members through three steps: analyze the body, set number-based goals, and coach every day. HAVIT brings that same flow to your phone.

**Here's what a clinical study found.** In a 12-week clinical study with Eulji University, **31.7%** of the HAVIT group lost 5% or more of their body weight, compared with 8.1% of the control group (about **3.9x**). **83%** of the HAVIT group lowered their body fat percentage, compared with 49% of the control group. The study ran June–August 2026 and analyzed 78 people (HAVIT 41, control 37) who had InBody results from both weeks 1 and 12. It was a non-blinded study, and HAVIT was involved in it. Results vary by individual.

### 1. AI Body Composition Analysis: Analyze Your Body Without Any Equipment, Then Track Your Way to Your Goal Weight in Numbers

![AI body composition analysis: ① Analyze → ② Set number-based goals → ③ Track toward your goal weight](/blog/havit/flow/en/havit-1-analysis.webp)

HAVIT asks for your height and weight, plus a few questions about your build and daily habits. From your answers it estimates your skeletal muscle mass and body fat mass, then analyzes your body type based on your muscle-to-fat balance (free). A scale alone can't tell you whether you lost fat or muscle. These are estimates, not InBody or DEXA measurements. Knowing the difference matters even more if you're on a GLP-1 medication like Wegovy or Zepbound. Lean mass has been reported to make up **40–60%** of weight lost in some trials and **15% or less** in others (Neeland 2024).

Based on your analysis, HAVIT sets **10 daily goals** in numbers. They cover:
- a calorie intake that never drops below your basal metabolic rate
- protein, carbs, fat, and fiber
- calories burned and steps
- sleep, water, and weigh-ins

The logging screen shows at a glance how close each meal gets you to your calorie and nutrient goals (macro analysis per meal and per day is HAVIT Premium).

### 2. AI Coach and 12-Week Method: 1:1 Feedback on Every Log

![1:1 coaching from the AI coach, plus a 12-week curriculum and healthy routines tailored to your plan](/blog/havit/flow/en/havit-2-coach.webp)

Every time you log, the AI coach HAVI tells you how you're tracking against today's goals and which nutrients you're short on. Then it suggests what to add at your next meal. Most calorie counters stop at the numbers. HAVIT keeps going.

**You start by building your plan in a conversation.** HAVI asks about your goals, whether you're on a GLP-1 and any side effects, and body details like height and weight. From your answers, it creates a **Body Blueprint** that sums up where your body is now, along with a goal plan.

**Every day, HAVI looks past calories to the rest of your logs.** Most calorie apps only look at what you ate. HAVI reviews your meal logs alongside your weight, water, sleep, steps, fasting, menstrual cycle, mood, and GLP-1 logs. A 1-minute check-in helps you map out the day together (daily check-ins are HAVIT Premium). Say you're staying within your calories, but you snack more the day after a short night's sleep. HAVI will point out that connection before telling you to cut calories further.

**You can ask with a photo.** Stuck between two snacks at the grocery store, or scanning a restaurant menu? Send a photo and ask which is the better pick. Free members have a daily chat limit, and HAVIT Premium makes it unlimited. At 10 pm, an **evening recap** wraps up your day, and you can leave a **one-line goal** for tomorrow (HAVIT Premium).

The team spent years supporting members in person at Juvis Diet. That experience taught them that sticking with logging over the long run matters more than hitting your calories exactly, so the app is built around consistency.

- **A 12-week program.** Each of the 12 stages has missions. Completion isn't self-reported. It's checked against your actual logs, like meals and steps.
- **Miss a day and keep your streak.** For missions that run several days in a row, your first miss is forgiven, a saver covers the second, and the third resets the mission. HAVIT Premium gives you 2 savers every week.

### 3. Tracking and Health Content: From GLP-1, Meals, and Sleep to Workouts, Meditation, and Articles

![The AI coach analyzes every log, and workouts, meditations, and articles help you learn and put it into practice](/blog/havit/flow/en/havit-3-records.webp)

**Calories per meal are free.** Search for a food or enter it manually, and your calories add up meal by meal. The **AI food scan**, which estimates the dish, its calories, and its nutrients from a single photo, is HAVIT Premium.

**The AI food scan is an estimate, too.** A photo can't show how much oil or sauce went into a dish. Use it to make sure home-cooked meals with lots of different dishes don't go unlogged. When the oil or portion sizes differ from usual, adjust them by hand.

Sleep, water, fasting, menstrual cycle, and GLP-1 tracking are all free. HAVI comments on each one as you log:
- **Sleep:** HAVI looks at how consistent your bedtime is, not just how long you slept.
- **Water:** it shows which times of day you tend to fall short.
- **Menstrual cycle:** you log symptoms along with your cycle, and coaching adjusts to where you are in it.
- **GLP-1:** you can set up a dosing schedule and reminders, then view them alongside your weight changes.
- **Running:** distance, time, and pace are tracked in real time, and you can see them on your lock screen.

The same app also has workout videos by category and **6 guided meditation types**: breathing and relaxation, sleep, stress and anxiety relief, appetite and craving control, focus, and gratitude (HAVIT Premium). They come in handy when your hunger is emotional.

### 4. Habits That Stick Like a Game

![Logs turn into rewards and friendly competition: streaks, steps, and coins → challenges, rankings, and characters](/blog/havit/flow/en/havit-4-game.webp)

Logging your steps, meals, and sleep earns coins. You can compete with friends in challenges and rankings, and use your coins to dress up your character. Every log turns into an instant reward, so you'll want to open the app every day even without anyone cheering you on.

- **Stay motivated like it's a game.** There are streaks, coins for steps, challenges and badges, and rankings.

faq.question: Does MacroFactor track GLP-1 medications like Ozempic or Wegovy?
faq.answer: No. MacroFactor is a macro-coaching app with no field for your medication, dose, injection date, or side effects. It coaches your nutrition in exceptional detail, but tracks nothing about your shot. For medication tracking you'd need a dedicated GLP-1 app alongside it, or an alternative that does both.

faq.question: What's the best MacroFactor alternative for GLP-1 users?
faq.answer: If you want medication tracking plus food logging in one app, a purpose-built GLP-1 tracker covers the shot side well, and HAVIT combines injection tracking, protein-first food logging, a body-composition estimate, and coaching. If macro-coaching depth is non-negotiable, you may prefer to keep MacroFactor and add a GLP-1 tracker.

faq.question: Is MacroFactor's protein coaching better than dedicated GLP-1 apps?
faq.answer: For macro precision, yes — clearly. MacroFactor's adaptive algorithm and verified database make protein targeting excellent. But most GLP-1 users also need dose tracking, side-effect logging, and a body-composition view, which MacroFactor doesn't offer. "Better" depends on whether macro depth or medication features matter more to you.

faq.question: Can MacroFactor tell me if I'm losing fat or muscle?
faq.answer: No. MacroFactor tracks your weight trend accurately but doesn't estimate body composition, so it can't show whether the pounds are coming off as fat or muscle. That distinction matters on a GLP-1, where the lean-mass share of weight lost has reached 40–60% in some trials.

faq.question: Is MacroFactor free?
faq.answer: No. MacroFactor has no free version — it's roughly $5.99–$11.99/month depending on plan, after a 7-day free trial. None of the tiers add GLP-1 medication tracking; that's a category the app doesn't cover. If you want a free path to log your shot, an alternative is worth a look.

faq.question: Can I use MacroFactor and a GLP-1 tracker together?
faq.answer: Yes, and many people do. Use MacroFactor for macro coaching and a dedicated GLP-1 app for dose, injection date, side effects, and reminders. The trade-off is juggling two apps and a subscription; an all-in-one alternative avoids that if you'd rather log everything in one place.

faq.question: Why doesn't MacroFactor just add dose tracking?
faq.answer: MacroFactor is deliberately focused on nutrition coaching and adaptive TDEE — that's its identity. Adding a full medication module (dose, side-effect correlation, titration, body composition) is a different product philosophy. Dedicated GLP-1 trackers were built around that from day one.

faq.question: Do these apps replace medical advice?
faq.answer: No. MacroFactor and every alternative here are tracking tools, not clinicians. Body-composition estimates and any medication-level views are educational approximations, not measurements. Follow your prescriber and pharmacist, and use your tracker to bring better data to your appointments.

faq.question: Is HAVIT better than MacroFactor?
faq.answer: It depends on what you are tracking. MacroFactor is built for general calorie and nutrition logging. HAVIT is built around a GLP-1 course — dose and injection-site logging, side-effect patterns tied to injection timing, body composition, and protein intake to protect lean mass. If you are on a GLP-1, HAVIT covers what a general tracker leaves out; if you only need calorie counting, MacroFactor is enough.

faq.question: What does HAVIT do that MacroFactor doesn't?
faq.answer: Dose and injection-site rotation, side effects logged against injection timing, body-composition trend tracking, and habit coaching that adapts to your own logged data. HAVIT combines medication management and behavior change in one place instead of splitting them across apps.

faq.question: Can I switch from MacroFactor to HAVIT?
faq.answer: Yes. Most people run both for a week or two — keep logging where you are comfortable while you set up your GLP-1 course in HAVIT — then move over once dose reminders and side-effect history are in place. Nothing about your prescription changes; HAVIT is a tracking companion, not a medical device.

## MacroFactor가 잘하는 점

MacroFactor는 Stronger By Science의 Greg Nuckols와 Eric Trexler가 만들었고, 근거 중심 사용자들 사이에서 명성을 얻었습니다.

### 진짜로 적응하는 TDEE

MacroFactor의 시그니처는 **적응형 소비 알고리즘**입니다. 일반 공식이 아니라, 실제 체중 추세와 기록한 섭취량으로 매주 총 에너지 소비(TDEE)를 재계산합니다 ([MacroFactor](https://macrofactor.com/macrofactor/)). 몸이 반응하면 칼로리·매크로 목표가 자동으로 조정됩니다. 알고리즘 속 영양 코치에 가장 가깝죠.

### 진짜 똑똑한 매크로·단백질 코칭

알고리즘이 매크로를 정하게 하거나(코치 모드), 비율을 직접 정하고 칼로리만 조정하게 할 수 있습니다(협업 모드) ([Arvo: MacroFactor 가격 2026](https://arvo.guru/vs/macrofactor)). 단백질 보존이 목표라면 고단백 목표를 고정해 두고 나머지를 앱에 맡길 수 있어 유용합니다.

### 검증된 고정확 DB

MacroFactor는 사용자 제출이 아닌 **NCC 기반 검증 음식 DB**를 씁니다 ([NutriScan: MacroFactor 비용 2026](https://nutriscan.app/blog/posts/macrofactor-cost-2026-free-version-29f5edc98b)). 단백질 6g이라고 하면 대체로 믿을 수 있어, 식욕이 준 상태에서 단백질을 챙길 때 특히 값집니다. 바코드, 커스텀 음식, 습관 트래커, 생리주기 트래커도 함께 제공됩니다.

## 비만주사 사용자에게 MacroFactor가 부족한 점

솔직한 핵심은 이겁니다. **MacroFactor는 영양 코칭 앱일 뿐입니다.** 매주 주사를 중심으로 도는 일상에는 근본적인 미스매치가 있습니다.

### 1. 주사 용량·투여일 기록이 없다

MacroFactor에는 약물명, mg 용량, 주사 날짜를 적을 칸이 없습니다. 매크로를 완벽하게 맞춰도 '언제 주사를 맞았는지'는 남지 않습니다. 주 1회 약물에서 가장 중요한 기록이 빠져 있는 셈입니다.

### 2. 부작용 로그가 없다

비만주사 사용자의 약 **40~70%가 메스꺼움·변비 같은 위장 부작용**을 겪습니다 ([BioSpace](https://www.biospace.com/drug-development/glp-1-side-effects-only-one-factor-driving-patient-discontinuation-rates)). 증상을 주사 타임라인과 함께 기록하면 "주사 이틀 뒤 메스꺼움 정점" 같은 패턴을 파악할 수 있는데, MacroFactor의 코칭은 소비·매크로 중심이지 약물 일정이 아닙니다.

### 4. 주사 알림·증량 지원이 없다

다음 주사 카운트다운도, 누락 처리도, 증량 예정 인식도 없습니다. MacroFactor의 알림은 기록·체중 측정 중심이지 약물 일정이 아닙니다.

MacroFactor는 **무료 버전이 없으며 앞으로도 없다고 밝혔습니다.** 7일 무료 체험 후 월 약 $11.99, 6개월 플랜 월 $7.99, 연간 월 $5.99($71.99/년)입니다 ([Arvo](https://arvo.guru/vs/macrofactor), [NutriScan](https://nutriscan.app/blog/posts/macrofactor-cost-2026-free-version-29f5edc98b)). 코칭은 그만한 값을 하지만, 그저 주사만 기록하고 싶은 사람에겐 무료 경로가 없습니다.

수면·수분·단식·생리 주기·GLP-1 기록은 무료입니다. 기록하면 HAVI가 하나하나 코멘트를 남깁니다. 수면은 시간뿐 아니라 잠드는 시각이 들쭉날쭉한지까지, 수분은 부족한 시간대까지 봅니다. 생리 주기는 증상과 함께 기록하면 주기에 맞춘 코칭을 받을 수 있습니다.

GLP-1은 투여 일정과 알림을 설정할 수 있고, 체중 변화와 나란히 볼 수 있습니다.

러닝은 거리·시간·페이스를 실시간으로 기록하고 잠금 화면에서도 확인할 수 있습니다.

카테고리별 운동 영상과 **가이드 명상 6가지**(호흡·이완/수면 유도/스트레스·불안 완화/식욕·갈망 조절/집중력/감사)도 같은 앱에 있습니다(하비트 프리미엄). 배고픔이 감정에서 올 때도 활용할 수 있습니다.

### 4. 게임처럼 이어지는 습관

![기록이 보상과 경쟁으로: 연속 기록·걸음 수·코인 → 챌린지·랭킹·캐릭터](/blog/havit/flow/ko/havit-4-game.webp)

걸음 수·식단·수면을 기록하면 코인이 쌓이고, 챌린지와 랭킹으로 친구들과 겨루며, 모은 코인으로 캐릭터를 꾸밀 수 있습니다. 누가 응원해 주지 않아도 매일 앱을 열고 싶어지도록, 기록이 바로 보상으로 이어지게 설계했습니다.

- **게임처럼 이어집니다.** 연속 기록, 걸음 수에 따른 코인, 챌린지와 배지, 랭킹이 있습니다.

comparison_table.caption: 하비트는 대사 과학을 기반으로 근육은 지키고 대사는 깨워, 요요 없는 몸을 오래 유지하도록 돕는 AI 건강 파트너입니다.

faq.question: MacroFactor로 오젬픽·위고비 같은 비만주사를 기록할 수 있나요?
faq.answer: 아니요. MacroFactor는 매크로 코칭 앱이라 약물명·용량·주사일·부작용을 적을 칸이 없습니다. 영양은 정밀하게 코칭하지만 주사에 관한 건 전혀 다루지 않습니다. 약물 기록엔 전용 앱을 함께 쓰거나, 둘 다 되는 대체 앱이 필요합니다.

faq.question: 비만주사 사용자에게 가장 좋은 MacroFactor 대체 앱은?
faq.answer: 약물 기록과 음식 기록을 한 앱에서 원하면 전용 트래커가 주사 쪽을 잘 커버하고, HAVIT은 주사 기록·단백질 우선 기록·체성분 추정·코칭을 결합합니다. 매크로 코칭 깊이가 절대 조건이면 MacroFactor를 유지하고 전용 트래커를 더하는 편이 나을 수 있습니다.

faq.question: MacroFactor의 단백질 코칭이 전용 비만주사 앱보다 좋나요?
faq.answer: 매크로 정밀도는 확실히 낫습니다. 적응형 알고리즘과 검증 DB로 단백질 목표가 우수하죠. 다만 대부분의 비만주사 사용자는 용량 기록·부작용 로그·체성분 관점도 필요한데 MacroFactor엔 없습니다. '더 낫다'는 매크로 깊이와 약물 기능 중 무엇이 중요한지에 달렸습니다.

faq.question: MacroFactor가 지방이 빠지는지 근육이 빠지는지 알려주나요?
faq.answer: 아니요. 체중 추세는 정확히 추적하지만 체성분은 추정하지 않아 지방/근육 구분을 못 합니다. 감량 체중 중 제지방 비율이 40~60%까지 보고되는 비만주사에서는 이 구분이 중요합니다.

faq.question: MacroFactor는 무료인가요?
faq.answer: 아니요. 무료 버전이 없고, 7일 체험 후 플랜에 따라 월 약 $5.99~$11.99입니다. 어느 요금제도 비만주사 약물 기록은 추가하지 않습니다. 주사를 기록할 무료 경로를 원하면 대체 앱을 살펴볼 만합니다.

faq.question: MacroFactor와 비만주사 트래커를 함께 쓸 수 있나요?
faq.answer: 네, 많이들 그렇게 합니다. MacroFactor로 매크로 코칭을, 전용 앱으로 용량·주사일·부작용·알림을 관리하죠. 대신 앱 두 개와 구독료를 감수해야 하고, 한곳에 다 기록하고 싶다면 올인원 대체 앱이 낫습니다.

faq.question: MacroFactor는 왜 용량 기록을 그냥 추가하지 않나요?
faq.answer: MacroFactor는 의도적으로 영양 코칭과 적응형 TDEE에 집중합니다. 그게 정체성이죠. 완전한 약물 모듈(용량·부작용 연동·증량·체성분)을 더하는 건 다른 제품 철학입니다. 전용 트래커는 처음부터 그걸 중심으로 만들어졌습니다.

faq.question: 이런 앱들이 의학적 조언을 대체하나요?
faq.answer: 아니요. MacroFactor를 포함해 여기 언급된 모든 앱은 기록 도구일 뿐 의료진이 아닙니다. 체성분 추정·약물 농도 표시는 교육용 근사치이지 측정값이 아닙니다. 처방의·약사의 지시를 따르고, 더 나은 데이터를 진료에 가져가세요.

faq.question: 하비트가 MacroFactor보다 나은가요?
faq.answer: 무엇을 기록하려는지에 따라 다릅니다. MacroFactor는 일반적인 칼로리·영양 기록에 맞춰져 있고, 하비트는 GLP-1 치료 과정을 축으로 설계됐습니다 — 용량·주사 부위 기록, 주사 시점과 연결된 부작용 패턴, 체성분, 제지방 보호를 위한 단백질 섭취까지 다룹니다. GLP-1을 쓰는 중이라면 일반 트래커가 놓치는 부분을 하비트가 메우고, 칼로리만 세면 된다면 MacroFactor로 충분합니다.

faq.question: MacroFactor에는 없고 하비트에만 있는 기능은 무엇인가요?
faq.answer: 용량·주사 부위 로테이션, 주사 타이밍에 붙는 부작용 기록, 체성분 추세, 그리고 기록한 데이터에 맞춰 조정되는 습관 코칭입니다. 약물 관리와 행동 변화를 앱 두 개로 쪼개지 않고 한 곳에서 다룹니다.

faq.question: MacroFactor에서 하비트로 갈아탈 수 있나요?
faq.answer: 가능합니다. 보통 1~2주는 둘을 함께 쓰면서 익숙한 쪽에 계속 기록하고, 하비트에 GLP-1 일정을 세팅합니다. 용량 알림과 부작용 이력이 쌓이면 그때 옮기면 됩니다. 처방은 그대로이며 하비트는 기록을 돕는 동반 앱이지 의료기기가 아닙니다.

zh-CN.title: GLP-1 用户的 MacroFactor 替代方案:2026 年诚实对比 — HAVIT vs MacroFactor
zh-CN.meta_description: 正在使用 GLP-1 并寻找 MacroFactor 替代方案?了解 MacroFactor 在宏量营养素指导方面的出色表现、为何它不跟踪你的剂量,以及应该寻找什么功能。
zh-CN.tldr: 正在使用 GLP-1 并寻找 MacroFactor 替代方案?了解 MacroFactor 在宏量营养素指导方面的出色表现、为何它不跟踪你的剂量,以及应该寻找什么功能。
zh-CN.body_md:
*医疗免责声明:本文仅供一般教育用途,不构成医疗建议、诊断或剂量指导。GLP-1 药物是处方药,具有严重的潜在风险。请始终遵循你的处方医生的指示和 FDA 批准的标签说明。切勿根据应用程序更改你的剂量。*

如果你正在使用 Ozempic、Wegovy、Mounjaro 或 Zepbound,并且搜索了'MacroFactor 替代方案',那么很可能你已经认可这款应用 — 它的宏量营养素指导可以说是市场上最智能的 — 但你遇到了它的局限:**它从未为你用药旅程的药物管理部分而构建。**

这是一次诚实、中立的对比。MacroFactor 是一款真正优秀的营养指导应用,对于数据驱动的节食者来说很难被超越。我们将充分肯定它在几乎所有方面做得更好的地方,直接指出它为 GLP-1 用户留下的空白,并列出在替代方案中应该寻找什么。问题不在于 MacroFactor 是否优秀 — 而在于仅靠宏量营养素指导是否是你在每周注射过程中所需要的。

## MacroFactor 的优势

MacroFactor 由 Stronger By Science 的 Greg Nuckols 和 Eric Trexler 开发,它在注重证据的用户中赢得声誉是有原因的。

### 真正自适应的 TDEE

MacroFactor 的标志性功能是**自适应能量消耗算法**,它每周根据你的真实体重趋势和记录的摄入量重新计算你的每日总能量消耗 — 而不是使用通用公式([MacroFactor](https://macrofactor.com/macrofactor/))。随着你身体的反应,你的卡路里和宏量营养素目标会自动调整。这是最接近营养教练的算法。

### 真正智能的宏量营养素和蛋白质指导

你可以让算法设置你的宏量营养素(指导模式)或自己设置比例并让它调整卡路里(协作模式)([Arvo: MacroFactor Pricing 2026](https://arvo.guru/vs/macrofactor))。对于蛋白质保留目标,这种灵活性很有价值 — 你可以锁定高蛋白质目标,让应用管理其余部分。每周检查和清晰的仪表板让整个过程感觉像是在接受指导。

### 经过验证的高精度数据库

MacroFactor 使用**基于 NCC 的经过验证的食物数据库**,而不是用户提交的条目([NutriScan: MacroFactor Cost 2026](https://nutriscan.app/blog/posts/macrofactor-cost-2026-free-version-29f5edc98b))。当它说某种食物含有 6 克蛋白质时,你通常可以相信 — 当你在食欲受抑制的情况下追求蛋白质摄入时,这确实很有用。条形码扫描、自定义食物、习惯跟踪器和经期跟踪器使其功能更加完善。

## MacroFactor 对 GLP-1 用户的不足之处

这是诚实的核心:**MacroFactor 是一款营养指导应用,仅此而已。**对于整个日常围绕每周注射的人来说,这是根本性的不匹配。

### 1. 没有剂量或注射跟踪

MacroFactor 没有用于记录你的药物、以毫克为单位的剂量或注射日期的字段。你可以完美地调整宏量营养素,但仍然没有记录何时注射的记录。对于每周一次的药物,这是最重要的跟踪事项 — 而它却缺失了。

### 2. 没有副作用日志

大约**40-70% 的 GLP-1 用户会经历胃肠道副作用**,如恶心和便秘([BioSpace](https://www.biospace.com/drug-development/glp-1-side-effects-only-one-factor-driving-patient-discontinuation-rates))。根据你的剂量时间线记录症状是 GLP-1 最有价值的习惯之一 — 你会了解到恶心在注射后两天达到峰值,并据此规划饮食。MacroFactor 的指导是围绕能量消耗和宏量营养素构建的,而不是药物时间表。

### 3. 没有身体成分视图

MacroFactor 出色地跟踪你的体重趋势,但它不估算身体成分。在使用 GLP-1 时,**在某些试验中减重中瘦体重的比例从 40-60% 到其他试验中的 15% 或更低不等**([Neeland et al., *Diabetes, Obesity and Metabolism*, 2024](https://dom-pubs.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/dom.15728))。下降的体重趋势看起来像是成功,即使你正在失去肌肉 — 而 MacroFactor 无法告诉你是哪种情况。

### 4. 没有注射提醒或剂量递增支持

没有下次注射的倒计时,没有漏针处理,也没有意识到你的剂量计划要增加。MacroFactor 的提醒是围绕记录和称重构建的,而不是药物时间表。

### 5. 仅付费 — 没有免费版本

MacroFactor **没有免费版本,永远不会有**;在 7 天免费试用后,费用约为每月 $11.99、6 个月计划每月 $7.99,或年度每月 $5.99(每年 $71.99)([Arvo](https://arvo.guru/vs/macrofactor),[NutriScan](https://nutriscan.app/blog/posts/macrofactor-cost-2026-free-version-29f5edc98b))。对于合适的用户来说,这种指导是值得的 — 但如果你只想记录注射,就没有免费途径。

## 对比表:MacroFactor vs 专用 GLP-1 跟踪器

诚实的框架:MacroFactor 是同类最佳的**宏量营养素指导应用**;专用 GLP-1 跟踪器是**药物和身体优先的应用**。它们解决的是不同的问题。

*功能和价格经常变化 — 在承诺之前请在 App Store 或 Google Play 中验证。来源:[MacroFactor](https://macrofactor.com/macrofactor/),[Arvo](https://arvo.guru/vs/macrofactor),[NutriScan](https://nutriscan.app/blog/posts/macrofactor-cost-2026-free-version-29f5edc98b)。*

### 关于差距的底线

差距不在于 MacroFactor 薄弱 — 而在于它在进行不同的运动。它在宏量营养素指导和自适应 TDEE 方面完胜。但它跟踪**零个**定义 GLP-1 旅程的药物信号(剂量、注射日期、副作用、时间表),并且无法告诉你是在减脂还是减肌肉。再多的宏量营养素精度也无法填补这些空白。

## 谁应该继续使用 MacroFactor — 谁应该切换

**继续使用 MacroFactor,如果:**
- 自适应 TDEE 和精确的宏量营养素指导是你的首要任务。
- 你乐意在其他地方单独记录你的药物。
- 你重视营养指导深度而不是在一个地方拥有药物功能。
- 订阅对于你的饮食和训练方式是值得的。

**考虑替代方案,如果:**
- 你希望在同一个应用中记录剂量、注射日期和副作用以及食物。
- 你想了解体重是以脂肪还是肌肉的形式减少。
- 你需要注射提醒和剂量递增意识。
- 你不想仅为跟踪注射而支付订阅费。

一个合理的中间路径:一些用户**配对使用** MacroFactor(用于宏量营养素指导)和专用 GLP-1 跟踪器(用于注射)。这可行 — 只是意味着两个应用和一个订阅。

## 在 MacroFactor 替代方案中寻找什么

如果你切换或添加第二个应用,请根据 GLP-1 基本要素评判候选应用:

1. **剂量 + 注射跟踪** — MacroFactor 完全无法做到的核心功能。
2. **与剂量时间线关联的副作用记录** — 以便你可以发现并规划模式。
3. **蛋白质优先的食物记录** — GLP-1 会降低食欲,蛋白质摄入不足会导致肌肉流失风险。
4. **身体成分意识** — 了解你是在减脂还是减肌肉,而不仅仅是体重。
5. **提醒和剂量递增支持** — 倒计时和剂量增加的意识。
6. **隐私** — 大多数美国健康应用不受 HIPAA 保护;阅读政策,优先选择导出/删除控制。
7. **免费途径** — 对于许多 GLP-1 用户来说,可以免费开始的应用胜过他们会付费但不会使用的指导。

## 关于准确性和安全性的说明

没有应用可以取代你的护理团队 — 不是 MacroFactor,也不是任何替代方案。手机上的身体成分数据是估算值,任何'估算的药物水平'曲线都是基于已发表半衰期的教育性近似值,绝不是对你体内药物的测量。使用你跟踪的任何内容向你的临床医生**提出更好的问题**,切勿因为应用显示的内容而调整剂量。

## 底线

MacroFactor 是该类别中最好的宏量营养素教练,如果自适应 TDEE 和精确的蛋白质目标是你的目标,它值得其声誉。但它不跟踪任何定义 GLP-1 旅程的药物信号 — 剂量、注射日期、副作用或时间表 — 并且无法告诉你是在减脂还是减肌肉。这不是缺陷;这只是 MacroFactor 的用途不在此。

如果你想要 GLP-1 注射跟踪、蛋白质优先的食物记录、AI 身体成分估算以保护肌肉,以及在一个地方的温和指导 — 围绕你的注射而不是宏量营养素算法组织 — **[试用 HAVIT 应用](https://www.aihavit.com/)**。它旨在帮助你在 GLP-1 旅程中保持一致,每周一次。如果你喜欢 MacroFactor 的指导,没有什么能阻止你同时使用两者。

## HAVIT：一个App，不只管饮食、营养和热量，更管好整个健康生活方式

GLP-1 药物可以显著减轻体重 — 但体重秤上的数字只是故事的一部分。GLP-1 治疗中减重的瘦体重比例在某些试验中从 40-60% 到其他试验中的 15% 或更低不等 — 瘦体重包括器官、骨骼和液体,而不仅仅是肌肉([Neeland et al., 2024](https://dom-pubs.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/dom.15728)),一旦停药,结果往往会消退,除非新习惯取而代之。这就是为什么领先的指导将药物视为护理的一部分,而不是全部:美国预防服务工作组建议为肥胖成人提供密集的多成分行为干预([USPSTF, Grade B](https://www.uspreventiveservicestaskforce.org/uspstf/recommendation/obesity-in-adults-interventions))。

**HAVIT是一款AI减重教练App，由来自韩国领先减重诊所之一「Juvis Diet」的专家打造。** 它不只记录饮食、营养和热量，还把体成分、睡眠、运动和情绪一并纳入，用一个App管好你的整个健康生活方式。诊所里由专人一对一陪伴的「身体分析 → 用数字设定目标 → 每天教练指导」这一套流程，现在在App里就能完成。

**临床研究结果如下。** 在与乙支大学合作的12周临床研究中，体重减少5%以上的人数占比，HAVIT使用组为**31.7%**，对照组为8.1%（约**3.9倍**）；体脂率下降的人数占比为**83%**（对照组49%）。这项研究于2026年6～8月进行，分析了第1周和第12周均有InBody数据的78人（HAVIT组41人、对照组37人），为非盲研究，且有HAVIT参与。效果因人而异。

### 1. AI体成分分析：无需仪器即可分析，用数字管理到目标体重

![AI体成分分析：① 分析 → ② 用数字定目标 → ③ 管理到目标体重](/blog/havit/flow/zh/havit-1-analysis.webp)

只需输入身高、体重，再回答几个关于体型和生活习惯的问题，就能估算骨骼肌量和体脂肪量，并根据肌肉与脂肪的比例分析出你的体型类型（免费）。因为光看体重秤上的数字，根本分不清「减掉的是脂肪还是肌肉」。这里给出的是估算值，并非InBody或DEXA的测量值。如果你正在使用Wegovy（司美格鲁肽）、Zepbound（替尔泊肽）等GLP-1类药物，这一点就更重要了。据报道，减掉的体重中去脂体重的占比在部分试验中达**40～60%**，在另一些试验中则为**15%以下**（Neeland 2024）。

根据分析结果，HAVIT会用数字为你设定**每日10项目标**：不低于基础代谢的摄入热量，蛋白质、碳水化合物、脂肪、膳食纤维，消耗热量、步数，以及睡眠、饮水、称重。在记录页面，每餐的热量和各项营养素完成到哪一步，一眼就能看清（每餐及全天三大营养素分析为HAVIT Premium功能）。

每次记录后，AI教练HAVI都会告诉你今天离目标还差多少、缺了哪些营养，并建议下一餐该补点什么。不是记个数字就完事——这正是它和普通热量计算App的不同之处。

**一开始，先通过对话制定计划。** HAVI会问你的目标、是否在用GLP-1及有无副作用、身高体重等身体信息，再根据你的回答生成一份概括当前身体状况的**身体蓝图**和目标计划。

**每天连热量之外的记录也一起看。** 一般的热量App只看你吃了什么。HAVI会把饮食记录和体重、饮水、睡眠、步数、断食、生理周期、心情、GLP-1记录放在一起看，再用1分钟签到和你一起定好今天的计划（每日签到为HAVIT Premium功能）。比如热量明明在目标之内，但偏偏每次睡不够的第二天零食就变多——这时HAVI不会急着让你再少吃点，而是先帮你指出这层关联。

**还能拍照咨询。** 在便利店纠结两样东西，或者外出就餐看着菜单拿不定主意时，拍张照发过去，问问哪个更好。免费用户每天的聊天次数有上限，HAVIT Premium则不限次数。每晚10点，你会收到一份总结当天的**晚间回顾**，还可以为明天留下一条**一句话目标**（HAVIT Premium）。

基于在Juvis Diet直接陪伴会员的经验，HAVIT更看重的不是把热量算得分毫不差，而是让你能长久坚持记录下去。

- **12周课程。** 12个阶段各有任务，是否完成不靠自己打勾，而是根据饮食、步数等记录来判定。
- **漏了一天也能接上。** 需要连续几天的任务，漏掉第1次可以通融，第2次用补签卡接上，第3次才需要重新开始。HAVIT Premium每周发放2张补签卡。

### 3. 记录管理与健康内容：从GLP-1、饮食、睡眠到运动、冥想、文章

![每条记录都有AI教练分析，再通过运动、冥想、文章边学边练](/blog/havit/flow/zh/havit-3-records.webp)

**每餐热量记录免费。** 搜索食物或手动输入，每餐的热量就会自动累计。只需一张照片就能估算出菜品及其热量、营养素的**AI拍照识食**为HAVIT Premium功能。

**AI拍照识食也是估算。** 照片拍不出油和酱汁用了多少。建议把它当作防止漏记的工具，尤其是一桌好几道菜的家常饭；如果油量或米饭量和平时不一样，记得手动调整。

睡眠、饮水、断食、生理周期、GLP-1记录均免费。每记录一项，HAVI都会给出点评。睡眠不只看时长，还会看入睡时间是否规律；饮水会看哪个时段喝得不够。生理周期可以连同身体感受一起记录，并收到配合周期的教练建议。

GLP-1可以设置用药日程和提醒，并和体重变化放在一起对照查看。

跑步时可实时记录距离、时间、配速，锁屏界面也能查看。

同一个App里还有分类运动视频，以及**6种引导式冥想**（呼吸放松／助眠／缓解压力和焦虑／管理食欲和嘴馋／专注力／感恩）（HAVIT Premium）。当饥饿感其实来自情绪时，也能派上用场。

### 4. 像玩游戏一样养成习惯

![记录变成奖励和竞赛：连续记录、步数、金币 → 挑战、排行榜、角色](/blog/havit/flow/zh/havit-4-game.webp)

记录步数、饮食、睡眠就能攒金币，通过挑战和排行榜与好友一较高下，还能用金币给角色换装。即使没人督促，也会想每天打开App——因为每一次记录都能马上换来奖励。

faq.question: MacroFactor 是否跟踪 Ozempic 或 Wegovy 等 GLP-1 药物?
faq.answer: 不。MacroFactor 是一款宏量营养素指导应用,没有用于记录你的药物、剂量、注射日期或副作用的字段。它以卓越的细节指导你的营养,但不跟踪任何关于你注射的信息。对于药物跟踪,你需要在它旁边使用专用的 GLP-1 应用,或使用同时具备两种功能的替代方案。

faq.question: 对于 GLP-1 用户来说,最好的 MacroFactor 替代方案是什么?
faq.answer: 如果你想在一个应用中进行药物跟踪和食物记录,专门构建的 GLP-1 跟踪器可以很好地覆盖注射方面,而 HAVIT 结合了注射跟踪、蛋白质优先的食物记录、身体成分估算和指导。如果宏量营养素指导深度是不可妥协的,你可能更愿意保留 MacroFactor 并添加 GLP-1 跟踪器。

faq.question: MacroFactor 的蛋白质指导是否优于专用 GLP-1 应用?
faq.answer: 在宏量营养素精度方面,是的 — 显然如此。MacroFactor 的自适应算法和经过验证的数据库使蛋白质目标设定非常出色。但大多数 GLP-1 用户还需要剂量跟踪、副作用记录和身体成分视图,而 MacroFactor 不提供这些。'更好'取决于宏量营养素深度还是药物功能对你更重要。

faq.question: MacroFactor 能告诉我是在减脂还是减肌肉吗?
faq.answer: 不能。MacroFactor 准确跟踪你的体重趋势,但不估算身体成分,因此无法显示减掉的磅数是脂肪还是肌肉。这种区别在 GLP-1 上很重要,因为在某些试验中减重的瘦体重比例达到了 40-60%。

faq.question: MacroFactor 是免费的吗?
faq.answer: 不是。MacroFactor 没有免费版本 — 根据计划,在 7 天免费试用后,费用约为每月 $5.99–$11.99。所有层级都不添加 GLP-1 药物跟踪;这是该应用不涵盖的类别。如果你想要免费途径来记录注射,值得考虑替代方案。

faq.question: 我可以同时使用 MacroFactor 和 GLP-1 跟踪器吗?
faq.answer: 可以,许多人这样做。使用 MacroFactor 进行宏量营养素指导,使用专用 GLP-1 应用进行剂量、注射日期、副作用和提醒。权衡是要处理两个应用和一个订阅;如果你更愿意在一个地方记录所有内容,一体化替代方案可以避免这种情况。

faq.question: 为什么 MacroFactor 不直接添加剂量跟踪?
faq.answer: MacroFactor 刻意专注于营养指导和自适应 TDEE — 这是它的身份。添加完整的药物模块(剂量、副作用关联、剂量递增、身体成分)是不同的产品理念。专用 GLP-1 跟踪器从一开始就围绕这一点构建。

faq.question: 这些应用能取代医疗建议吗?
faq.answer: 不能。MacroFactor 和这里的每个替代方案都是跟踪工具,而不是临床医生。身体成分估算和任何药物水平视图都是教育性近似值,而不是测量值。遵循你的处方医生和药剂师,并使用你的跟踪器为你的预约带来更好的数据。

faq.question: HAVIT 比 MacroFactor 更好吗?
faq.answer: 这取决于你跟踪的内容。MacroFactor 是为一般卡路里和营养记录而构建的。HAVIT 是围绕 GLP-1 疗程构建的 — 剂量和注射部位记录、与注射时间相关的副作用模式、身体成分和蛋白质摄入以保护瘦体重。如果你正在使用 GLP-1,HAVIT 涵盖了一般跟踪器遗漏的内容;如果你只需要卡路里计数,MacroFactor 就足够了。

faq.question: HAVIT 做了哪些 MacroFactor 没有做的事情?
faq.answer: 剂量和注射部位轮换、根据注射时间记录的副作用、身体成分趋势跟踪,以及适应你自己记录数据的习惯指导。HAVIT 将药物管理和行为改变结合在一个地方,而不是将它们分散在多个应用中。

faq.question: 我可以从 MacroFactor 切换到 HAVIT 吗?
faq.answer: 可以。大多数人会同时运行两者一两周 — 在你习惯的地方继续记录,同时在 HAVIT 中设置你的 GLP-1 疗程 — 然后一旦剂量提醒和副作用历史就位就转移过来。你的处方没有任何变化;HAVIT 是一个跟踪伴侣,而不是医疗设备。HAVIT 不是医疗诊断工具。

es.meta_description: ¿Buscas una alternativa a MacroFactor mientras usas un GLP-1? Lo que MacroFactor hace brillantemente en coaching de macros, por qué no rastrea tu dosis y qué buscar.
es.tldr: ¿Buscas una alternativa a MacroFactor mientras usas un GLP-1? Lo que MacroFactor hace brillantemente en coaching de macros, por qué no rastrea tu dosis y qué buscar.
es.body_md:
*Aviso médico: Este artículo es solo para educación general y no constituye consejo médico, diagnóstico ni orientación de dosificación. Los medicamentos GLP-1 son fármacos con receta que conllevan riesgos potenciales graves. Siempre sigue las instrucciones de tu médico y la etiqueta aprobada por la FDA. Nunca cambies tu dosis basándote en una aplicación.*

Si estás usando Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro o Zepbound y buscaste una 'alternativa a MacroFactor', es muy probable que ya respetes la aplicación — su coaching de macros es posiblemente el más inteligente del mercado — pero has llegado a su límite: **nunca fue diseñada para el lado medicinal de tu proceso.**

Esta es una comparación honesta y neutral. MacroFactor es una aplicación de coaching nutricional genuinamente excelente, y para quienes buscan datos precisos es difícil de superar. Le daremos pleno crédito por lo que hace mejor que casi cualquier otra, seremos directos sobre el vacío que deja para usuarios de GLP-1, y explicaremos qué buscar en una alternativa. La pregunta no es si MacroFactor es buena — es si el coaching de macros solo es lo que necesitas cuando te inyectas semanalmente.

## Lo que MacroFactor hace bien

MacroFactor fue creada por Greg Nuckols y Eric Trexler de Stronger By Science, y se ganó su reputación entre usuarios basados en evidencia por una razón.

### TDEE adaptativo que realmente se adapta

La característica distintiva de MacroFactor es un **algoritmo de gasto adaptativo** que recalcula tu gasto energético diario total cada semana a partir de tus tendencias reales de peso e ingesta registrada — no una fórmula genérica ([MacroFactor](https://macrofactor.com/macrofactor/)). A medida que tu cuerpo responde, tus objetivos de calorías y macros se ajustan automáticamente. Es lo más cercano a un coach nutricional en forma de algoritmo.

### Coaching de macros y proteína genuinamente inteligente

Puedes dejar que el algoritmo establezca tus macros (modo guiado) o establecer tus propias proporciones y dejar que ajuste las calorías (modo colaborativo) ([Arvo: MacroFactor Pricing 2026](https://arvo.guru/vs/macrofactor)). Para un objetivo de preservación de proteína, esa flexibilidad es valiosa — puedes fijar un objetivo alto de proteína y dejar que la app gestione el resto. Los chequeos semanales y paneles limpios hacen que todo se sienta como coaching.

### Una base de datos verificada de alta precisión

MacroFactor usa una **base de datos de alimentos verificada derivada de NCC** en lugar de entradas enviadas por usuarios ([NutriScan: MacroFactor Cost 2026](https://nutriscan.app/blog/posts/macrofactor-cost-2026-free-version-29f5edc98b)). Cuando dice que un alimento tiene 6 gramos de proteína, generalmente puedes confiar — genuinamente útil cuando buscas proteína con apetito suprimido. Escaneo de códigos de barras, alimentos personalizados, rastreador de hábitos y rastreador de periodo lo completan.

## Dónde MacroFactor se queda corta para usuarios de GLP-1

Aquí está el núcleo honesto: **MacroFactor es una aplicación de coaching nutricional, punto.** Para alguien cuya rutina completa gira en torno a una inyección semanal, eso es un desajuste fundamental.

### 1. Sin rastreo de dosis o inyección

MacroFactor no tiene ningún campo para tu medicamento, tu dosis en miligramos o tu fecha de inyección. Puedes ajustar tus macros perfectamente y aún así no tener registro de cuándo te aplicaste la inyección. Para un medicamento de una vez por semana, eso es lo más importante que rastrear — y está ausente.

### 2. Sin registro de efectos secundarios

Aproximadamente **40–70% de los usuarios de GLP-1 experimentan efectos secundarios gastrointestinales** como náuseas y estreñimiento ([BioSpace](https://www.biospace.com/drug-development/glp-1-side-effects-only-one-factor-driving-patient-discontinuation-rates)). Registrar síntomas contra tu cronología de dosis es uno de los hábitos GLP-1 de mayor valor — aprendes que las náuseas alcanzan su pico dos días después de la inyección y planificas comidas en consecuencia. El coaching de MacroFactor está construido alrededor del gasto y macros, no de un calendario de medicación.

### 3. Sin vista de composición corporal

MacroFactor rastrea tu tendencia de peso brillantemente, pero no estima composición corporal. En un GLP-1, **la proporción de masa magra del peso perdido ha variado desde 40–60% en algunos ensayos hasta 15% o menos en otros** ([Neeland et al., *Diabetes, Obesity and Metabolism*, 2024](https://dom-pubs.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/dom.15728)). Una tendencia de peso descendente parece éxito incluso cuando estás perdiendo músculo — y MacroFactor no puede decirte cuál.

### 4. Sin recordatorios de inyección o soporte de titulación

No hay cuenta regresiva para tu próxima inyección, sin manejo de dosis perdidas, y sin conciencia de que tu dosis está programada para aumentar. Los recordatorios de MacroFactor están construidos alrededor del registro y pesajes, no de un calendario de medicación.

### 5. Solo de pago — sin nivel gratuito

MacroFactor **no tiene versión gratuita y nunca la tendrá**; cuesta aproximadamente $11.99/mes, $7.99/mes en el plan de 6 meses, o $5.99/mes anualmente ($71.99/año), después de una prueba gratuita de 7 días ([Arvo](https://arvo.guru/vs/macrofactor), [NutriScan](https://nutriscan.app/blog/posts/macrofactor-cost-2026-free-version-29f5edc98b)). El coaching vale la pena para el usuario correcto — pero no hay camino gratuito si solo quieres registrar tu inyección.

## Tabla comparativa: MacroFactor vs rastreadores dedicados de GLP-1

El encuadre honesto: MacroFactor es una **aplicación de coaching de macros** de primera clase; los rastreadores dedicados de GLP-1 son **aplicaciones centradas en medicación y cuerpo**. Están resolviendo problemas diferentes.

*Las características y precios cambian frecuentemente — verifica en la App Store o Google Play antes de comprometerte. El vacío no es que MacroFactor sea débil — es que está jugando un deporte diferente. Gana en coaching de macros y TDEE adaptativo sin discusión. Si cambias, o añades una segunda app, juzga a los candidatos por fundamentos GLP-1:

7. **Un camino gratuito** — para muchos usuarios de GLP-1, una app que pueden comenzar gratis supera al coaching por el que pagarán pero no usarán.

Ninguna aplicación reemplaza a tu equipo de atención médica — ni MacroFactor, ni ninguna alternativa. Las cifras de composición corporal desde un teléfono son estimaciones, y cualquier curva de 'nivel estimado de medicación' es una aproximación educativa basada en vidas medias publicadas, nunca una medición del fármaco en tu cuerpo. Usa lo que rastrees para llevar **mejores preguntas a tu médico**, y nunca ajustes tu dosis por lo que muestra una aplicación.

MacroFactor es el mejor coach de macros en la categoría, y si el TDEE adaptativo y objetivos precisos de proteína son tu meta, merece su reputación. Pero no rastrea ninguna de las señales de medicación que definen un proceso GLP-1 — dosis, fecha de inyección, efectos secundarios o calendario — y no puede decirte si estás perdiendo grasa o músculo. Esta é uma comparação honesta e neutra. O MacroFactor é um aplicativo de coaching nutricional genuinamente excelente, e para pessoas que fazem dieta baseada em dados, é difícil de superar. Vamos dar crédito total pelo que ele faz melhor do que quase qualquer outro, ser diretos sobre a lacuna que deixa para usuários de GLP-1 e explicar o que procurar em uma alternativa. A questão não é se o MacroFactor é bom — é se o coaching de macros sozinho é o que você precisa com uma injeção semanal.

## O Que o MacroFactor Faz Bem

O MacroFactor foi criado por Greg Nuckols e Eric Trexler da Stronger By Science, e conquistou sua reputação entre usuários orientados por evidências por uma razão.

### TDEE adaptativo que realmente se adapta

A marca registrada do MacroFactor é um **algoritmo de gasto energético adaptativo** que recalcula seu gasto energético diário total toda semana a partir de suas tendências reais de peso e ingestão registrada — não uma fórmula genérica ([MacroFactor](https://macrofactor.com/macrofactor/)). À medida que seu corpo responde, suas metas de calorias e macros se ajustam automaticamente. É o mais próximo de um coach nutricional em forma de algoritmo.

### Coaching de macros e proteínas genuinamente inteligente

Você pode deixar o algoritmo definir seus macros (modo coaching) ou definir suas próprias proporções e deixá-lo ajustar as calorias (modo colaborativo) ([Arvo: MacroFactor Pricing 2026](https://arvo.guru/vs/macrofactor)). Para uma meta de preservação de proteína, essa flexibilidade é valiosa — você pode fixar uma meta alta de proteína e deixar o aplicativo gerenciar o resto. Check-ins semanais e painéis limpos fazem tudo parecer um coaching.

### Um banco de dados verificado e de alta precisão

O MacroFactor usa um **banco de dados de alimentos verificado derivado do NCC** em vez de entradas enviadas por usuários ([NutriScan: MacroFactor Cost 2026](https://nutriscan.app/blog/posts/macrofactor-cost-2026-free-version-29f5edc98b)). Quando diz que um alimento tem 6 gramas de proteína, você geralmente pode confiar — genuinamente útil quando você está buscando proteína com apetite suprimido. Leitura de código de barras, alimentos personalizados, rastreador de hábitos e rastreador de ciclo menstrual completam o pacote.

## Onde o MacroFactor Fica Aquém para Usuários de GLP-1

Aqui está o núcleo honesto: **o MacroFactor é um aplicativo de coaching nutricional, ponto final.** Para alguém cuja rotina inteira gira em torno de uma injeção semanal, isso é uma incompatibilidade fundamental.

### 1. Sem rastreamento de dose ou injeção

O MacroFactor não tem campo para seu medicamento, sua dose em miligramas ou sua data de injeção. Você pode ajustar seus macros perfeitamente e ainda não ter registro de quando tomou sua injeção. Para um medicamento de uso semanal, essa é a coisa mais importante a rastrear — e está ausente.

### 2. Sem registro de efeitos colaterais

Aproximadamente **40–70% dos usuários de GLP-1 experimentam efeitos colaterais gastrointestinais** como náusea e constipação ([BioSpace](https://www.biospace.com/drug-development/glp-1-side-effects-only-one-factor-driving-patient-discontinuation-rates)). Registrar sintomas em relação à sua linha do tempo de dose é um dos hábitos de maior valor para GLP-1 — você aprende que a náusea atinge o pico dois dias após a injeção e planeja refeições em torno disso. O coaching do MacroFactor é construído em torno de gasto energético e macros, não de um cronograma de medicação.

### 3. Sem visualização de composição corporal

O MacroFactor rastreia sua tendência de peso brilhantemente, mas não estima composição corporal. Em um GLP-1, **a parcela de massa magra do peso perdido variou de 40–60% em alguns estudos a 15% ou menos em outros** ([Neeland et al., *Diabetes, Obesity and Metabolism*, 2024](https://dom-pubs.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/dom.15728)). Uma tendência de peso em queda parece sucesso mesmo quando você está perdendo músculo — e o MacroFactor não pode te dizer qual.

### 4. Sem lembretes de injeção ou suporte de titulação

Não há contagem regressiva para sua próxima injeção, sem tratamento de dose perdida e sem consciência de que sua dose está programada para aumentar. Os lembretes do MacroFactor são construídos em torno de registro e pesagens, não de um cronograma de medicação.

### 5. Apenas pago — sem versão gratuita

O MacroFactor **não tem versão gratuita e nunca terá**; custa cerca de $11,99/mês, $7,99/mês no plano de 6 meses, ou $5,99/mês anualmente ($71,99/ano), após um teste gratuito de 7 dias ([Arvo](https://arvo.guru/vs/macrofactor), [NutriScan](https://nutriscan.app/blog/posts/macrofactor-cost-2026-free-version-29f5edc98b)). O coaching vale a pena para o usuário certo — mas não há caminho gratuito se você só quer registrar sua injeção.

O enquadramento honesto: o MacroFactor é um **aplicativo de coaching de macros** de primeira classe; rastreadores dedicados de GLP-1 são **aplicativos focados em medicação e corpo**. Eles estão resolvendo problemas diferentes.

### A linha de fundo sobre a lacuna

A lacuna não é que o MacroFactor seja fraco — é que ele está jogando um esporte diferente. Ele vence em coaching de macros e TDEE adaptativo sem dúvida. Mas rastreia **zero** dos sinais de medicação que definem uma jornada de GLP-1 (dose, data de injeção, efeitos colaterais, cronograma), e não pode te dizer se você está perdendo gordura ou músculo. Nenhuma quantidade de precisão de macros preenche esses buracos.

## Quem Deve Continuar no MacroFactor — e Quem Deve Trocar

**Continue no MacroFactor se:**
- TDEE adaptativo e coaching preciso de macros são suas principais prioridades.
- Você está feliz registrando sua medicação separadamente, em outro lugar.
- Você valoriza profundidade de coaching nutricional sobre recursos de medicação em um só lugar.
- A assinatura vale a pena pela forma como você come e treina.

**Considere uma alternativa se:**

- Você precisa de lembretes de injeção e consciência de titulação.
- Você prefere não pagar uma assinatura apenas para rastrear sua injeção.

Um caminho intermediário razoável: alguns usuários **combinam** o MacroFactor (para coaching de macros) com um rastreador dedicado de GLP-1 (para a injeção). Isso funciona — só significa dois aplicativos e uma assinatura.

## O Que Procurar em uma Alternativa ao MacroFactor

Se você trocar, ou adicionar um segundo aplicativo, julgue os candidatos nos fundamentos de GLP-1:

1. **Rastreamento de dose + injeção** — o núcleo que o MacroFactor não faz de jeito nenhum.
2. **Registro de efeitos colaterais vinculado à sua linha do tempo de dose** — para que você possa identificar e planejar em torno de padrões.
3. **Registro de alimentos com foco em proteína** — o apetite cai em um GLP-1, e comer pouca proteína arrisca perda muscular.
4. **Consciência de composição corporal** — saiba se você está perdendo gordura ou músculo, não apenas peso.
5. **Lembretes e suporte de titulação** — contagens regressivas e consciência de aumentos de dose.
6. **Privacidade** — a maioria dos aplicativos de bem-estar dos EUA não são cobertos pela HIPAA; leia a política, prefira controles de exportação/exclusão.
7. **Um caminho gratuito** — para muitos usuários de GLP-1, um aplicativo que podem começar gratuitamente supera um coaching pelo qual pagarão mas não usarão.

## Uma Nota sobre Precisão e Segurança

Nenhum aplicativo substitui sua equipe de cuidados — nem o MacroFactor, nem qualquer alternativa. Números de composição corporal de um telefone são estimativas, e qualquer curva de 'nível de medicação estimado' é uma aproximação educacional baseada em meias-vidas publicadas, nunca uma medição da droga em seu corpo. Use o que você rastreia para trazer **melhores perguntas ao seu médico**, e nunca ajuste sua dose por causa do que um aplicativo mostra.

## A Linha de Fundo

O MacroFactor é o melhor coach de macros da categoria, e se TDEE adaptativo e metas precisas de proteína são seu objetivo, ele merece sua reputação. Mas não rastreia nenhum dos sinais de medicação que definem uma jornada de GLP-1 — dose, data de injeção, efeitos colaterais ou cronograma — e não pode te dizer se você está perdendo gordura ou músculo. Isso não é uma falha; simplesmente não é para o que o MacroFactor serve.

Se você quer rastreamento de injeção de GLP-1, registro de alimentos com foco em proteína, uma estimativa de composição corporal por IA para que você possa proteger o músculo, e coaching gentil em um só lugar — organizado em torno da sua injeção em vez de em torno de um algoritmo de macros — **[experimente o aplicativo HAVIT](https://www.aihavit.com/)**. Ele foi construído para mantê-lo consistente em sua jornada de GLP-1, uma semana de cada vez. E se você ama o coaching do MacroFactor, não há nada impedindo você de usar ambos.

## HAVIT: um só app para cuidar não só de refeições, nutrientes e calorias, mas de todo o seu estilo de vida saudável

Medicamentos GLP-1 podem reduzir significativamente o peso — mas o número na balança é apenas parte da história. A parcela de massa magra do peso perdido na terapia com GLP-1 variou de 40–60% em alguns estudos a 15% ou menos em outros — e massa magra conta órgãos, ossos e fluidos, não apenas músculo ([Neeland et al., 2024](https://dom-pubs.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/dom.15728)), e os resultados tendem a desaparecer uma vez que a medicação para, a menos que novos hábitos tomem seu lugar. É por isso que orientações líderes tratam a medicação como uma parte do cuidado, não o todo: a U.S. Preventive Services Task Force recomenda que adultos com obesidade recebam intervenções comportamentais intensivas e multicomponentes ([USPSTF, Grade B](https://www.uspreventiveservicestaskforce.org/uspstf/recommendation/obesity-in-adults-interventions)).

## Di Mana MacroFactor Kurang untuk Pengguna GLP-1

Inilah inti yang jujur: **MacroFactor adalah aplikasi pembinaan nutrisi, titik.** Untuk seseorang yang seluruh rutinnya berkisar pada suntikan mingguan, itu adalah ketidakcocokan fundamental.

### 1. Tidak ada pelacakan dosis atau suntikan

MacroFactor tidak memiliki bidang untuk obat Anda, dosis Anda dalam miligram, atau tanggal suntikan Anda. Anda dapat menyesuaikan makro Anda dengan sempurna dan tetap tidak memiliki catatan kapan Anda mengambil suntikan. Untuk obat sekali seminggu, itu adalah hal paling penting untuk dilacak — dan tidak ada.

### 2. Tidak ada log efek samping

Sekitar **40–70% pengguna GLP-1 mengalami efek samping GI** seperti mual dan sembelit ([BioSpace](https://www.biospace.com/drug-development/glp-1-side-effects-only-one-factor-driving-patient-discontinuation-rates)). Mencatat gejala terhadap timeline dosis Anda adalah salah satu kebiasaan GLP-1 dengan nilai tertinggi — Anda belajar bahwa mual mencapai puncaknya dua hari pasca-suntikan dan merencanakan makanan di sekitarnya. Pembinaan MacroFactor dibangun di sekitar pengeluaran dan makro, bukan jadwal pengobatan.

### 3. Tidak ada tampilan komposisi tubuh

MacroFactor melacak tren berat badan Anda dengan brilian, tetapi tidak memperkirakan komposisi tubuh. Pada GLP-1, **bagian massa tanpa lemak dari berat yang hilang berkisar dari 40–60% dalam beberapa uji coba hingga 15% atau kurang pada yang lain** ([Neeland et al., *Diabetes, Obesity and Metabolism*, 2024](https://dom-pubs.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/dom.15728)). Tren berat badan yang turun terlihat seperti kesuksesan bahkan ketika Anda kehilangan otot — dan MacroFactor tidak dapat memberi tahu Anda yang mana.

### 4. Tidak ada pengingat suntikan atau dukungan titrasi

Tidak ada hitung mundur ke suntikan berikutnya, tidak ada penanganan dosis yang terlewat, dan tidak ada kesadaran bahwa dosis Anda dijadwalkan untuk naik. Pengingat MacroFactor dibangun di sekitar pencatatan dan penimbangan, bukan jadwal pengobatan.

### 5. Hanya berbayar — tidak ada tingkat gratis

MacroFactor **tidak memiliki versi gratis dan tidak akan pernah ada**; biayanya sekitar $11,99/bulan, $7,99/bulan pada paket 6 bulan, atau $5,99/bulan tahunan ($71,99/tahun), setelah uji coba gratis 7 hari ([Arvo](https://arvo.guru/vs/macrofactor), [NutriScan](https://nutriscan.app/blog/posts/macrofactor-cost-2026-free-version-29f5edc98b)). Pembinaan ini sepadan untuk pengguna yang tepat — tetapi tidak ada jalur gratis jika Anda hanya ingin mencatat suntikan Anda.

Framing yang jujur: MacroFactor adalah **aplikasi pembinaan makro** terbaik di kelasnya; pelacak GLP-1 khusus adalah **aplikasi yang mengutamakan pengobatan dan tubuh**. Mereka memecahkan masalah yang berbeda.

### Kesimpulan tentang kesenjangan

Kesenjangannya bukan bahwa MacroFactor lemah — tetapi bahwa ia bermain olahraga yang berbeda. Ia menang dalam pembinaan makro dan TDEE adaptif tanpa keraguan. Tetapi ia melacak **nol** dari sinyal pengobatan yang mendefinisikan perjalanan GLP-1 (dosis, tanggal suntikan, efek samping, jadwal), dan tidak dapat memberi tahu Anda apakah Anda kehilangan lemak atau otot. Tidak ada jumlah presisi makro yang mengisi lubang-lubang itu.

## Siapa yang Harus Tetap di MacroFactor — dan Siapa yang Harus Beralih

**Tetap di MacroFactor jika:**
- TDEE adaptif dan pembinaan makro yang presisi adalah prioritas utama Anda.
- Anda senang mencatat obat Anda secara terpisah, di tempat lain.
- Anda menghargai kedalaman pembinaan nutrisi daripada fitur pengobatan dalam satu tempat.
- Langganan sepadan dengan cara Anda makan dan berlatih.

**Pertimbangkan alternatif jika:**
- Anda ingin dosis, tanggal suntikan, dan efek samping Anda dalam aplikasi yang sama dengan makanan Anda.
- Anda ingin melihat apakah berat badan turun sebagai lemak atau otot.
- Anda memerlukan pengingat suntikan dan kesadaran titrasi.
- Anda lebih suka tidak membayar langganan hanya untuk melacak suntikan Anda.

Jalur tengah yang masuk akal: beberapa pengguna **memasangkan** MacroFactor (untuk pembinaan makro) dengan pelacak GLP-1 khusus (untuk suntikan). Itu berhasil — hanya saja berarti dua aplikasi dan langganan.

## Apa yang Harus Dicari dalam Alternatif MacroFactor

Jika Anda beralih, atau menambahkan aplikasi kedua, nilai kandidat berdasarkan fundamental GLP-1:

1. **Pelacakan dosis + suntikan** — inti yang sama sekali tidak dapat dilakukan MacroFactor.
2. **Pencatatan efek samping yang terkait dengan timeline dosis Anda** — sehingga Anda dapat menemukan dan merencanakan di sekitar pola.
3. **Pencatatan makanan yang mengutamakan protein** — nafsu makan turun pada GLP-1, dan kurang makan protein berisiko kehilangan otot.
4. **Kesadaran komposisi tubuh** — ketahui apakah Anda kehilangan lemak atau otot, bukan hanya berat badan.
5. **Pengingat dan dukungan titrasi** — hitung mundur dan kesadaran kenaikan dosis.
6. **Privasi** — sebagian besar aplikasi kesehatan AS tidak tercakup HIPAA; baca kebijakannya, lebih suka kontrol ekspor/hapus.
7. **Jalur gratis** — untuk banyak pengguna GLP-1, aplikasi yang dapat mereka mulai gratis mengalahkan pembinaan yang akan mereka bayar tetapi tidak gunakan.

## Catatan tentang Akurasi dan Keamanan

Tidak ada aplikasi yang menggantikan tim perawatan Anda — bukan MacroFactor, bukan alternatif apa pun. Angka komposisi tubuh dari ponsel adalah perkiraan, dan kurva 'tingkat pengobatan yang diperkirakan' apa pun adalah perkiraan edukatif berdasarkan waktu paruh yang dipublikasikan, tidak pernah pengukuran obat dalam tubuh Anda. Gunakan apa pun yang Anda lacak untuk membawa **pertanyaan yang lebih baik kepada klinisi Anda**, dan jangan pernah menyesuaikan dosis Anda karena apa yang ditunjukkan aplikasi.

## Kesimpulan

MacroFactor adalah pelatih makro terbaik dalam kategorinya, dan jika TDEE adaptif dan target protein yang presisi adalah tujuan Anda, ia layak mendapat reputasinya. Tetapi ia tidak melacak sinyal pengobatan apa pun yang mendefinisikan perjalanan GLP-1 — dosis, tanggal suntikan, efek samping, atau jadwal — dan tidak dapat memberi tahu Anda apakah Anda kehilangan lemak atau otot. Itu bukan cacat; itu hanya bukan untuk apa MacroFactor dibuat.

Jika Anda menginginkan pelacakan suntikan GLP-1, pencatatan makanan yang mengutamakan protein, perkiraan komposisi tubuh AI sehingga Anda dapat melindungi otot, dan pembinaan lembut dalam satu tempat — diorganisir di sekitar suntikan Anda alih-alih di sekitar algoritma makro — **[coba aplikasi HAVIT](https://www.aihavit.com/)**. Ini dibangun untuk menjaga Anda konsisten dalam perjalanan GLP-1 Anda, satu minggu pada satu waktu. Dan jika Anda menyukai pembinaan MacroFactor, tidak ada yang menghentikan Anda dari menggunakan keduanya.

## HAVIT: Satu aplikasi untuk mengelola makan, nutrisi, dan kalori, sekaligus seluruh gaya hidup sehat Anda

Obat GLP-1 dapat secara bermakna mengurangi berat badan — tetapi angka pada timbangan hanya bagian dari cerita. Bagian massa tanpa lemak dari berat yang hilang pada terapi GLP-1 berkisar dari 40–60% dalam beberapa uji coba hingga 15% atau kurang pada yang lain — dan massa tanpa lemak menghitung organ, tulang dan cairan, tidak hanya otot ([Neeland et al., 2024](https://dom-pubs.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/dom.15728)), dan hasilnya cenderung memudar setelah pengobatan berhenti kecuali kebiasaan baru menggantikannya. Itulah mengapa panduan terkemuka memperlakukan pengobatan sebagai satu bagian dari perawatan, bukan keseluruhan: U.S. Preventive Services Task Force merekomendasikan bahwa orang dewasa dengan obesitas ditawarkan intervensi perilaku multikomponen yang intensif ([USPSTF, Grade B](https://www.uspreventiveservicestaskforce.org/uspstf/recommendation/obesity-in-adults-interventions)).

**HAVIT adalah aplikasi pelatih diet AI yang dibuat oleh para ahli dari Juvis Diet, salah satu klinik diet terkemuka di Korea.** HAVIT tidak hanya mengelola makan, nutrisi, dan kalori. Komposisi tubuh, tidur, olahraga, hingga kesehatan mental juga diatur dalam satu aplikasi. Alur yang selama ini didampingi langsung oleh tenaga ahli di klinik, yaitu "analisis tubuh → tetapkan target dengan angka → coaching setiap hari", kini bisa Anda jalani lewat aplikasi.

**Berikut hasil studi klinisnya.** Dalam studi klinis 12 minggu bersama Universitas Eulji, **31,7%** pengguna HAVIT berhasil menurunkan berat badan 5% atau lebih, dibandingkan 8,1% pada kelompok kontrol (sekitar **3,9 kali** lipat). Proporsi peserta yang persentase lemak tubuhnya turun mencapai **83%** (kelompok kontrol 49%). Studi non-blinded ini dilakukan pada Juni–Agustus 2026 dan menganalisis 78 peserta yang memiliki hasil InBody minggu ke-1 dan ke-12 (HAVIT 41 orang, kelompok kontrol 37 orang). HAVIT terlibat dalam studi ini. Hasil dapat berbeda pada setiap orang.

### 1. Analisis komposisi tubuh AI: dianalisis tanpa alat, lalu dipantau dengan angka sampai berat target

![Analisis komposisi tubuh AI: ① Analisis → ② Target berupa angka → ③ Pantau berat target](/blog/havit/flow/id/havit-1-analysis.webp)

Dari tinggi dan berat badan, ditambah beberapa pertanyaan soal bentuk tubuh dan kebiasaan sehari-hari, HAVIT memperkirakan massa otot rangka dan massa lemak. Dari keseimbangan otot dan lemak itu, tipe tubuh Anda juga dianalisis (gratis). Alasannya, angka di timbangan saja tidak bisa memberi tahu apakah yang turun itu lemak atau otot. Hasilnya berupa estimasi, bukan hasil pengukuran InBody atau DEXA. Kalau Anda memakai GLP-1 (misalnya Wegovy atau Mounjaro), hal ini makin penting. Proporsi massa bebas lemak dari total berat badan yang turun dilaporkan sebesar **40–60%** di sebagian uji klinis, dan **15% atau kurang** di uji lainnya (Neeland 2024).

Berdasarkan hasil analisis, HAVIT menetapkan **10 target harian** dalam bentuk angka: asupan kalori yang tidak di bawah metabolisme basal; protein, karbohidrat, lemak, dan serat; kalori terbakar dan jumlah langkah; serta tidur, minum air, dan penimbangan berat badan. Di layar catatan, Anda bisa melihat sekilas sejauh mana kalori dan nutrisi tiap waktu makan sudah tercapai (analisis makro per waktu makan dan per hari tersedia di HAVIT Premium).

### 2. Pelatih AI dan metode 12 minggu: komentar 1:1 untuk setiap catatan harian

![Coaching 1:1 dari pelatih AI, plus kurikulum 12 minggu dan rutinitas sehat sesuai program](/blog/havit/flow/id/havit-2-coach.webp)

Setiap kali Anda mencatat, pelatih AI HAVI memberi tahu progres Anda terhadap target hari ini dan nutrisi apa yang masih kurang, lalu menyarankan apa yang perlu ditambahkan di waktu makan berikutnya. Aplikasi hitung kalori biasa berhenti di angka. HAVIT tidak.

**Awalnya, rencana disusun lewat percakapan.** HAVI menanyakan tujuan Anda, apakah Anda memakai GLP-1 dan efek sampingnya, serta data tubuh seperti tinggi dan berat badan. Dari jawaban itu, HAVI menyusun **Body Blueprint** yang merangkum kondisi tubuh Anda saat ini, beserta rencana target.

**Setiap hari, yang dicek bukan cuma kalori.** Aplikasi kalori umumnya hanya melihat apa yang Anda makan. HAVI mengecek catatan makan bersama catatan berat badan, minum air, tidur, langkah, puasa, siklus menstruasi, suasana hati, dan GLP-1, lalu menentukan rencana hari ini bersama Anda lewat check-in 1 menit (check-in harian tersedia di HAVIT Premium). Misalnya, kalori Anda masih dalam target, tapi camilan selalu bertambah setiap kali Anda kurang tidur malam sebelumnya. Sebelum menyuruh Anda memangkas kalori lagi, HAVI akan menunjukkan kaitan itu lebih dulu.

**Bisa berkonsultasi lewat foto.** Bingung memilih di antara dua produk di Indomaret atau Alfamart, atau memilih menu saat makan di luar? Kirim fotonya dan tanyakan mana yang lebih baik. Pengguna gratis punya batas jumlah chat per hari, sedangkan HAVIT Premium tanpa batas. Setiap pukul 10 malam, Anda menerima **rangkuman malam** tentang hari itu dan bisa menuliskan **target singkat** untuk besok (HAVIT Premium).

Dari pengalaman mendampingi langsung para member di Juvis Diet, HAVIT lebih menekankan cara agar Anda bisa terus mencatat dalam jangka panjang, bukan mencocokkan kalori sampai pas.

- **Program 12 minggu.** Program ini terdiri dari 12 tahap, masing-masing dengan misinya sendiri. Pencapaiannya dinilai dari catatan seperti makan dan jumlah langkah, bukan dari pengakuan sendiri.
- **Tetap tersambung meski ada hari yang bolong.** Untuk misi yang harus dijalani beberapa hari berturut-turut, bolong pertama masih dimaklumi, bolong kedua ditambal dengan saver, dan bolong ketiga membuat misi diulang dari awal. Pengguna HAVIT Premium mendapat 2 saver setiap minggu.

### 3. Pengelolaan catatan dan konten kesehatan: dari GLP-1, makan, dan tidur sampai olahraga, meditasi, dan artikel

![Pelatih AI menganalisis setiap catatan, lalu Anda belajar dan mempraktikkannya lewat olahraga, meditasi, dan artikel](/blog/havit/flow/id/havit-3-records.webp)

**Kalori per waktu makan bisa dicatat gratis.** Cari makanan atau input manual, dan kalori per waktu makan akan dijumlahkan secara otomatis. **AI Food Scan**, yang memperkirakan jenis makanan, kalori, dan nutrisinya hanya dari satu foto, tersedia di HAVIT Premium.

**AI Food Scan juga hanya estimasi.** Jumlah minyak atau saus tidak kelihatan di foto. Pakai fitur ini supaya Anda tidak lupa mencatat makanan rumahan dengan banyak lauk, lalu koreksi manual kalau porsi minyak atau nasinya berbeda dari biasanya.

Catatan tidur, minum air, puasa, siklus menstruasi, dan GLP-1 gratis. HAVI memberi komentar untuk setiap catatan. Untuk tidur, yang dilihat bukan cuma durasinya, tapi juga jam tidur yang tidak teratur. Untuk minum air, HAVI melihat di jam berapa saja asupan Anda kurang. Siklus menstruasi dicatat bersama gejalanya, lalu Anda mendapat coaching yang disesuaikan dengan siklus.

Untuk GLP-1, Anda bisa mengatur jadwal pemakaian dan pengingat, lalu melihatnya berdampingan dengan perubahan berat badan.

Saat lari, jarak, waktu, dan pace tercatat secara real-time dan bisa dilihat juga dari layar kunci.

Video olahraga per kategori dan **6 jenis meditasi terpandu** (napas dan relaksasi / pengantar tidur / meredakan stres dan cemas / mengendalikan nafsu makan dan ngidam / fokus / rasa syukur) juga ada di aplikasi yang sama (HAVIT Premium). Meditasi ini juga berguna saat rasa lapar sebenarnya datang dari perasaan.

### 4. Kebiasaan yang bertahan karena terasa seperti main game

![Catatan berubah jadi hadiah dan kompetisi: streak, langkah, koin → tantangan, peringkat, karakter](/blog/havit/flow/id/havit-4-game.webp)

Setiap kali mencatat langkah, makan, dan tidur, Anda mengumpulkan koin. Anda bisa bersaing dengan teman lewat tantangan dan peringkat, lalu memakai koin untuk mengganti pakaian karakter. Karena setiap catatan langsung berbuah hadiah, Anda ingin membuka aplikasi setiap hari tanpa perlu disemangati orang lain.

- **Bertahan karena terasa seperti main game.** Ada streak, koin sesuai jumlah langkah, tantangan dan lencana, serta peringkat.

de.body_md:
*Medizinischer Haftungsausschluss: Dieser Artikel dient ausschließlich der allgemeinen Aufklärung und stellt keine medizinische Beratung, Diagnose oder Dosierungsempfehlung dar. GLP-1-Medikamente sind verschreibungspflichtige Arzneimittel mit ernsthaften potenziellen Risiken. Befolgen Sie stets die Anweisungen Ihres verschreibenden Arztes und die von der FDA zugelassene Kennzeichnung. Ändern Sie niemals Ihre Dosis aufgrund einer App.*

Wenn Sie Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro oder Zepbound nehmen und nach einer 'MacroFactor-Alternative' gesucht haben, respektieren Sie die App wahrscheinlich bereits — ihr Makro-Coaching ist wohl das intelligenteste auf dem Markt — aber Sie sind an ihre Grenzen gestoßen: **Sie wurde nie für die Medikamentenseite Ihrer Reise entwickelt.**

Dies ist ein ehrlicher, herstellerneutraler Vergleich. MacroFactor ist eine wirklich exzellente Ernährungs-Coaching-App, und für datengetriebene Diäthaltende ist sie schwer zu schlagen. Wir werden ihr volle Anerkennung dafür geben, was sie besser macht als fast alle anderen, direkt über die Lücke sprechen, die sie für GLP-1-Anwender hinterlässt, und darlegen, worauf Sie bei einer Alternative achten sollten. Die Frage ist nicht, ob MacroFactor gut ist — sondern ob Makro-Coaching allein das ist, was Sie bei einer wöchentlichen Injektion brauchen.

## Was MacroFactor gut macht

MacroFactor wurde von Greg Nuckols und Eric Trexler von Stronger By Science entwickelt und hat sich seinen Ruf unter evidenzorientierten Nutzern aus gutem Grund verdient.

### Adaptiver TDEE, der sich tatsächlich anpasst

MacroFactors Markenzeichen ist ein **adaptiver Verbrauchsalgorithmus**, der Ihren Gesamttagesenergieverbrauch jede Woche aus Ihren tatsächlichen Gewichtstrends und protokollierter Aufnahme neu berechnet — keine generische Formel ([MacroFactor](https://macrofactor.com/macrofactor/)). Während Ihr Körper reagiert, passen sich Ihre Kalorien- und Makroziele automatisch an. Es ist das Nächste an einem Ernährungscoach in einem Algorithmus.

### Wirklich intelligentes Makro- und Protein-Coaching

Sie können den Algorithmus Ihre Makros festlegen lassen (Coached-Modus) oder Ihre eigenen Verhältnisse einstellen und ihn die Kalorien anpassen lassen (Collaborative-Modus) ([Arvo: MacroFactor Pricing 2026](https://arvo.guru/vs/macrofactor)). Für ein Proteinerhaltungsziel ist diese Flexibilität wertvoll — Sie können ein hohes Proteinziel fixieren und die App den Rest verwalten lassen. Wöchentliche Check-ins und übersichtliche Dashboards lassen das Ganze wie Coaching anfühlen.

### Eine verifizierte, hochpräzise Datenbank

MacroFactor verwendet eine **NCC-abgeleitete verifizierte Lebensmitteldatenbank** statt nutzergesteuerter Einträge ([NutriScan: MacroFactor Cost 2026](https://nutriscan.app/blog/posts/macrofactor-cost-2026-free-version-29f5edc98b)). Wenn dort steht, ein Lebensmittel hat 6 Gramm Protein, können Sie dem im Allgemeinen vertrauen — wirklich nützlich, wenn Sie bei unterdrücktem Appetit Protein anstreben. Barcode-Scanning, individuelle Lebensmittel, ein Gewohnheitstracker und ein Periodentracker runden es ab.

## Wo MacroFactor für GLP-1-Anwender zu kurz greift

Hier ist der ehrliche Kern: **MacroFactor ist eine Ernährungs-Coaching-App, Punkt.** Für jemanden, dessen gesamte Routine sich um eine wöchentliche Injektion dreht, ist das eine grundlegende Diskrepanz.

### 1. Kein Dosis- oder Injektionstracking

MacroFactor hat kein Feld für Ihr Medikament, Ihre Dosis in Milligramm oder Ihr Injektionsdatum. Sie können Ihre Makros perfekt einstellen und haben trotzdem keine Aufzeichnung darüber, wann Sie Ihre Spritze genommen haben. Für ein einmal wöchentliches Medikament ist das die wichtigste Sache zum Tracken — und sie fehlt.

### 2. Kein Nebenwirkungsprotokoll

Etwa **40–70 % der GLP-1-Anwender erleben gastrointestinale Nebenwirkungen** wie Übelkeit und Verstopfung ([BioSpace](https://www.biospace.com/drug-development/glp-1-side-effects-only-one-factor-driving-patient-discontinuation-rates)). Symptome gegen Ihre Dosiszeitlinie zu protokollieren, ist eine der wertvollsten GLP-1-Gewohnheiten — Sie lernen, dass Übelkeit zwei Tage nach der Spritze ihren Höhepunkt erreicht und planen Mahlzeiten entsprechend. MacroFactors Coaching ist um Verbrauch und Makros herum aufgebaut, nicht um einen Medikamentenplan.

### 3. Keine Körperzusammensetzungsansicht

MacroFactor trackt Ihren Gewichtstrend brillant, schätzt aber keine Körperzusammensetzung. Bei einem GLP-1 **lag der Anteil der Magermasse am verlorenen Gewicht in einigen Studien bei 40–60 %, in anderen bei 15 % oder weniger** ([Neeland et al., *Diabetes, Obesity and Metabolism*, 2024](https://dom-pubs.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/dom.15728)). Ein fallender Gewichtstrend sieht nach Erfolg aus, selbst wenn Sie Muskeln verlieren — und MacroFactor kann Ihnen nicht sagen, welches.

### 4. Keine Spritzenerinnerungen oder Titrationsunterstützung

Es gibt keinen Countdown zu Ihrer nächsten Injektion, keine Handhabung vergessener Dosen und kein Bewusstsein dafür, dass Ihre Dosis planmäßig erhöht werden soll. MacroFactors Erinnerungen sind um Protokollierung und Wiegevorgänge herum aufgebaut, nicht um einen Medikamentenplan.

### 5. Nur kostenpflichtig — keine kostenlose Version

MacroFactor hat **keine kostenlose Version und wird nie eine haben**; es kostet etwa $11,99/Monat, $7,99/Monat beim 6-Monats-Plan oder $5,99/Monat jährlich ($71,99/Jahr), nach einer 7-tägigen kostenlosen Testversion ([Arvo](https://arvo.guru/vs/macrofactor), [NutriScan](https://nutriscan.app/blog/posts/macrofactor-cost-2026-free-version-29f5edc98b)). Das Coaching ist es für den richtigen Nutzer wert — aber es gibt keinen kostenlosen Weg, wenn Sie nur Ihre Spritze protokollieren möchten.

## Vergleichstabelle: MacroFactor vs. dedizierte GLP-1-Tracker

Die ehrliche Einordnung: MacroFactor ist eine erstklassige **Makro-Coaching-App**; dedizierte GLP-1-Tracker sind **Medikamenten-und-Körper-zuerst-Apps**. Sie lösen unterschiedliche Probleme.

*Funktionen und Preise ändern sich häufig — überprüfen Sie im App Store oder Google Play, bevor Sie sich festlegen. Quellen: [MacroFactor](https://macrofactor.com/macrofactor/), [Arvo](https://arvo.guru/vs/macrofactor), [NutriScan](https://nutriscan.app/blog/posts/macrofactor-cost-2026-free-version-29f5edc98b).*

### Das Fazit zur Lücke

Die Lücke besteht nicht darin, dass MacroFactor schwach ist — sondern dass es eine andere Sportart spielt. Es gewinnt Makro-Coaching und adaptiven TDEE haushoch. Aber es trackt **null** der Medikamentensignale, die eine GLP-1-Reise definieren (Dosis, Injektionsdatum, Nebenwirkungen, Zeitplan), und es kann Ihnen nicht sagen, ob Sie Fett oder Muskeln verlieren. Keine Makropräzision füllt diese Lücken.

## Wer bei MacroFactor bleiben sollte — und wer wechseln sollte

**Bleiben Sie bei MacroFactor, wenn:**
- Adaptiver TDEE und präzises Makro-Coaching Ihre obersten Prioritäten sind.
- Sie damit zufrieden sind, Ihr Medikament separat woanders zu protokollieren.
- Sie Ernährungs-Coaching-Tiefe über Medikamentenfunktionen an einem Ort schätzen.
- Das Abonnement es wert ist für die Art, wie Sie essen und trainieren.

**Erwägen Sie eine Alternative, wenn:**
- Sie Ihre Dosis, Ihr Injektionsdatum und Nebenwirkungen in derselben App wie Ihr Essen wollen.
- Sie sehen möchten, ob Gewicht als Fett oder Muskel abgebaut wird.
- Sie Spritzenerinnerungen und Titrationsbewusstsein brauchen.
- Sie lieber kein Abonnement bezahlen möchten, nur um Ihre Spritze zu tracken.

Ein vernünftiger Mittelweg: Einige Nutzer **kombinieren** MacroFactor (für Makro-Coaching) mit einem dedizierten GLP-1-Tracker (für die Spritze). Das funktioniert — bedeutet nur zwei Apps und ein Abonnement.

## Worauf Sie bei einer MacroFactor-Alternative achten sollten

Wenn Sie wechseln oder eine zweite App hinzufügen, beurteilen Sie Kandidaten nach GLP-1-Grundlagen:

1. **Dosis- + Injektionstracking** — das Kernstück, das MacroFactor überhaupt nicht kann.
2. **Nebenwirkungsprotokollierung verknüpft mit Ihrer Dosiszeitlinie** — damit Sie Muster erkennen und entsprechend planen können.
3. **Protein-zuerst-Lebensmittelprotokollierung** — der Appetit sinkt bei einem GLP-1, und zu wenig Protein zu essen riskiert Muskelverlust.
4. **Körperzusammensetzungsbewusstsein** — wissen Sie, ob Sie Fett oder Muskel verlieren, nicht nur Gewicht.
5. **Erinnerungen und Titrationsunterstützung** — Countdowns und Bewusstsein für Dosiserhöhungen.
6. **Datenschutz** — die meisten US-Wellness-Apps sind nicht HIPAA-konform; lesen Sie die Richtlinie, bevorzugen Sie Export-/Löschkontrollen.
7. **Ein kostenloser Weg** — für viele GLP-1-Anwender schlägt eine App, die sie kostenlos starten können, ein Coaching, für das sie bezahlen, aber nicht nutzen werden.

## Eine Anmerkung zu Genauigkeit und Sicherheit

Keine App ersetzt Ihr Behandlungsteam — nicht MacroFactor, nicht irgendeine Alternative. Körperzusammensetzungszahlen vom Telefon sind Schätzungen, und jede 'geschätzte Medikamentenspiegel'-Kurve ist eine pädagogische Annäherung basierend auf veröffentlichten Halbwertszeiten, niemals eine Messung des Medikaments in Ihrem Körper. Nutzen Sie, was Sie tracken, um **bessere Fragen an Ihren Arzt** zu stellen, und passen Sie niemals Ihre Dosis aufgrund dessen an, was eine App zeigt.

## Das Fazit

MacroFactor ist der beste Makro-Coach in der Kategorie, und wenn adaptiver TDEE und präzise Proteinziele Ihr Ziel sind, verdient es seinen Ruf. Aber es trackt keines der Medikamentensignale, die eine GLP-1-Reise definieren — Dosis, Injektionsdatum, Nebenwirkungen oder Zeitplan — und es kann Ihnen nicht sagen, ob Sie Fett oder Muskel verlieren. Das ist kein Fehler; es ist einfach nicht das, wofür MacroFactor da ist.

Wenn Sie GLP-1-Injektionstracking, Protein-zuerst-Lebensmittelprotokollierung, eine KI-Körperzusammensetzungsschätzung zum Muskelschutz und sanftes Coaching an einem Ort wollen — organisiert um Ihre Spritze herum statt um einen Makro-Algorithmus — **[probieren Sie die HAVIT-App](https://www.aihavit.com/)**. Sie ist gebaut, um Sie auf Ihrer GLP-1-Reise konsequent zu halten, eine Woche nach der anderen. Und wenn Sie MacroFactors Coaching lieben, hindert Sie nichts daran, beides zu nutzen.

## HAVIT: Ernährung, Nährwerte und Kalorien – und dein ganzer gesunder Lebensstil in einer App

GLP-1-Medikamente können das Gewicht bedeutsam reduzieren — aber die Zahl auf der Waage ist nur ein Teil der Geschichte. Der Anteil der Magermasse am verlorenen Gewicht bei GLP-1-Therapie lag in einigen Studien bei 40–60 %, in anderen bei 15 % oder weniger — und Magermasse zählt Organe, Knochen und Flüssigkeit, nicht nur Muskel ([Neeland et al., 2024](https://dom-pubs.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/dom.15728)), und Ergebnisse verblassen tendenziell, sobald das Medikament gestoppt wird, es sei denn, neue Gewohnheiten treten an ihre Stelle. Deshalb behandelt führende Leitlinie Medikation als einen Teil der Versorgung, nicht das Ganze: Die U.S. Preventive Services Task Force empfiehlt, dass Erwachsenen mit Adipositas intensive, multikomponentige Verhaltensinterventionen angeboten werden sollten ([USPSTF, Grade B](https://www.uspreventiveservicestaskforce.org/uspstf/recommendation/obesity-in-adults-interventions)).

**HAVIT ist eine KI-Diät-Coach-App, entwickelt von Fachleuten aus Juvis Diet, einer der führenden Diätkliniken Koreas.** HAVIT erfasst nicht nur Mahlzeiten, Nährwerte und Kalorien. In einer einzigen App begleitet sie deinen ganzen gesunden Lebensstil, von der Körperzusammensetzung über Schlaf und Bewegung bis zum mentalen Wohlbefinden. In der Klinik haben Fachleute die Mitglieder persönlich in drei Schritten begleitet: „Körper analysieren → Ziele in Zahlen festlegen → täglich coachen“. Genau diesen Ablauf bildet die App nach.

In der HAVIT-Gruppe sank bei **83 %** der Körperfettanteil (Kontrollgruppe: 49 %). Ausgewertet wurden von Juni bis August 2026 die Daten von 78 Personen (HAVIT 41, Kontrollgruppe 37), für die InBody-Messungen aus Woche 1 und Woche 12 vorlagen. Es handelt sich um eine nicht verblindete Studie, an der HAVIT beteiligt war. Die Ergebnisse können individuell unterschiedlich ausfallen.

### 1. KI-Körperanalyse: Analyse ohne Messgerät und Zahlen bis zum Wunschgewicht
